_readme: Student offers shown in PerkScan's Student mode. Only add an offer from the provider's own page,
with source_url and last_verified. No prices: they change and differ by country.
countries: [] means the provider offers it worldwide. Then run: npm run seed:build
Checked 2026-10-22 against the providers' official help/education pages (via web search).

offers.name: GitHub Student Developer Pack
offers.summary: Free access to a bundle of developer tools and services from GitHub and its partners.
offers.eligibility: Enrolled in a degree or diploma program, at least 13 years old, with a personal GitHub account.
offers.how_to_verify: School email address, or proof of current enrollment such as a student ID or transcript.

offers.name: JetBrains free student license
offers.summary: Free individual licenses for JetBrains tools (such as IntelliJ IDEA and PyCharm), valid one year and renewable while you study.
offers.eligibility: Enrolled at an accredited school, college or university in a program of a year or more of full-time study.
offers.how_to_verify: School email address, an ISIC card, or a GitHub Student Developer Pack account.

offers.name: Figma for Education
offers.summary: Figma's Education plan, free for verified students (Professional plan for higher education).
offers.eligibility: Students and educators, 13 or older, applying with their school email.
offers.how_to_verify: Apply at figma.com/education; verification is done by SheerID.

offers.name: Notion Plus for students
offers.summary: Notion's Plus plan free for college and university students.
offers.eligibility: Students at an accredited college or university (not K-12).
offers.how_to_verify: Sign up with your school email, then Settings → Upgrade plan → Get free education plan.

offers.name: Autodesk Education
offers.summary: One year of free access to Autodesk software for learning, renewable while you're eligible. Not for commercial work.
offers.eligibility: Students and educators at qualified educational institutions.
offers.how_to_verify: Autodesk checks your student status when you sign up for education access.

offers.name: Microsoft 365 Education
offers.summary: Free web versions of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote and Teams for students at eligible schools. What's included depends on your school's license.
offers.eligibility: Students at an eligible school or university.
offers.how_to_verify: Sign up with your school email address.
